alt: Light trails curve along railway tracks beside a dim underground platform.
A seated person in a patterned shirt raises both arms beside colorful fabrics and produce.
Black-and-white street scene of a person in a cap walking with a cane.
A cyclist in a white helmet passes motion-blurred storefronts.
Two people stand under a red umbrella in heavy rain beneath illuminated billboards.
Defocused traffic and neon signs reflect across wet pavement at night.
Pedestrians cross a rain-soaked street beneath colorful illuminated billboards.
Pedestrians carrying umbrellas cross a wet street below large film billboards.
Silhouetted onlookers frame a distant torch-bearing statue and an orange sunset.
A crowd stands beside a row of windows beneath fluorescent ceiling lights.
Worn wooden rocking chairs in a dim room lit by a window.
A torch-bearing statue stands beside the setting sun above dark water.
A person holds a fishing rod beside a waterfront railing at dusk.
Red and white traffic light trails pass beneath tall buildings at dusk.
Buses and cars travel along a tree-lined avenue between tall buildings.
The Golden Gate Bridge in low sunset light, seen from a beach as waves break over dark rocks and the tower reflects in wet sand.
A red Golden Gate Bridge tower and its cables at dusk, with the San Francisco skyline small behind it.
A red-and-white ferry passes beneath the Golden Gate Bridge deck while cars cross above at dusk.
